When one of your AI subscriptions hits its usage limit, your Agents move over to another one and keep working in the same conversation, so you're never stuck waiting for a limit to reset.

If you already have bots on Grok Bot, you can bring all of them over to Turnstone, and their skills and routines come with them. We made a bot that does the move for you: 

If you haven't tried Grok Bot yet but want to try something like it with the AI you already have, Turnstone is a great place to start. And if you don't pay for any AI yet, you can still get started with some free open source models we provide. [...] The gallery above shows the rest of what your Agents can do, from working in your apps to running Routines on their own every morning. You can send them work from your iPhone while they keep running on your Mac. Turnstone is completely free to use on your Mac, and it will stay that way.

Since it's Hypership Day 🚀, drop anything you wish Turnstone did in the comments and we'll try to ship as much of it as we can today. Our only goal is to free everyone's work from usage limits they can't control!

We re now going through every comment and piece of feedback from the launch. Some of it has already influenced what we want to improve next.  
This launch was not the finish line. It was the beginning of the next stage for OpenBot.  
Thank you again for making this launch special. We re just getting started.

### We finished #2 Product of the Day - thank you! 🎉

Yesterday, OpenBot launched on Product Hunt and finished as the #2 Product of the Day with 350 upvotes.  
Honestly, we didn t know what to expect. Seeing so many people support OpenBot, test the product, ask questions, and share honest feedback meant a lot to our entire team.  
Thank you to everyone who:  
- upvoted and commented,  
- shared our launch,  
- downloaded and tested OpenBot,  
- reported bugs,  
- or told us what we should build next.
